Streuseled Sweet Potato Casserole
By: Arielle
Published: Thursday, November 25, 2010 - 7:14am

Ingredients




5 pounds of sweet potatoes
1/2 cup half and half
1/2 cup maple syrup
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
3/4 teaspoon salt
1 egg
Cooking spray
1/2 cup flour
1/2 cup packed brown sugar
1/4 cup butter cubed
1/2 cup chopped pecans

Preparation

1 Place potatoes in the pot and put water over them. Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer. Boil until softened. You will be able to stick a fork in them and not be able to pick them up. Once they are soft take them out of the water and allow them to cool. 2 While you are waiting for the potatoes to boil put the egg in the mixer and beat just a bit. Then add the half and half, maple syrup, vanilla and salt. Mix lightly. 3 Then put the flour and brown sugar in the food processor. Pulse to mix. Then cut the butter into cubes and put into the processor. Mix until crumbly. Chop the pecans and stir in. 4 Once potatoes are cool place in egg mixture and mix well. Then pour into the greased baking dish. 5 Spread the crumble mixture over the top. 6 Bake covered for 15 minutes and then uncovered for 25 minutes
